Road Block clues are challenges that only one team member may perform before moving on. Since Season 6, each team member
needs to participate in an equal amount of Road Blocks as their partner, assuming they make it all the way through the race. 
Sometimes, Road Blocks will require teams to travel (normally run) to the finish line after completing the challenge, effectively serving as an 
additional Route Info clue requiring teams to travel to the finish line.
